title: Gauge Fixing for Quantum Vertex Algebra Deformations
exact_target: Find a workable gauge for perturbing quantum vertex algebras and identify the physical fields represented by its action.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000365 (OWR-1114-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Heterotic Strings, Derived Categories, and Stacks (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/53, pp. 3019--3060; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 28--30, printed pages 3046--3048.
heterotic Kodaira--Spencer theory at one loop; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The required gauge and physical interpretation are two separate targets. The report's proposed fivebrane interpretation is suggestive context, not an established identification or a definition that may be assumed.
